title: Stunstick
description: This mod add police stunstick, stunbaton to minecraft.
body:
______________________________________________________________________________
# DESCRIPTION

_**Hello everyone, guys. I have been playing Minecraft for more than 15 years and decided to start learning modding. As a simple mod, I decided to make a police baton (rubber stick)._

_This thing is perfect for your role-playing scenarios. The mod does not require any libraries.**_ **[ENG]**

______________________________________________________________________________
# ОПИСАНИЕ

_**Всем привет ребята. Я в майнкрафт играю уже более 15 лет и решил заняться изучением моддинга. В качестве простого мода я решил сделать полицейскую дубинку (палка резиновая)._

_Эта штука идеально подойдёт для ваших ролевых ситуаций. Мод не требует каких либо библиотек.**_ **[RUS]**

______________________________________________________________________________

# **CRAFT / КРАФТ:**

![Craft recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ff9a8a22481a7887ed8aa86adfae714b28a8c650.jpeg)
______________________________________________________________________________
# **FEATURES**

1. Achievements - Democracy Tool, Democracy Training +XP
2. RUS/ENG Translation
3. Have crafting recipe
**Survival**- have crafting recipe (coal, iron, stick)
**Creative** - In creative menu (tools)
______________________________________________________________________________

# **ACHIEVEMENTS**

There are two achievements. One is for creating or having a club, the second is for using it on any entity, that is, roughly speaking, you need to hit any mob or even a player. Each of the achievements gives experience.

![Achievements](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/83da35cb662b680418bbc08d3f430f18e1789c90.jpeg)

______________________________________________________________________________

- 1.0.3 - add achievements+translating to Russian



- 1.0.1 - add craft recipe


- 1.0.0 - add stunstick
